 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANJANI KUMAR SHARAN  ORAL ORDER 3 21-04-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
The petitioners are apprehending their arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 341, 323, 504, 506, 354(B) of the Indian Penal Code.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are innocent and have been falsely implicated in this case.

He submits that there is general and omnibus Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.2550 of 2023(3) dt.21-04-2023 allegation levelled against the petitioners.
He submits that there is a civil dispute and no criminal liability is made out against the petitioners.
He submits that occurrence took place on 09.07.2022 but the FIR has been lodged on 26.07.2022 after delay of 17 days without explaining any reasonable cause of delay.

He further submits that petitioners have no Ramu Sahni vs The State Of Bihar on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115910949/
1 criminal antecedent as stated in para-3 of this application.

sentences.text: Learned APP for the State opposes the prayer for bail.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that there is delay in lodging the FIR, let the above named petitioners in the event of their arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned court below where the case is pending/successor court in connection with Minapur P.S. Case No. 385 of 2022, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Cr.P.C.
(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) devendra/-
